settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
1. Prepare – Cleanse the client’s skin using our Mangosteen Cleanser and apply a generous layer of Restore or Renu conductive gel.
  2. Select Settings – Power on the MyoLift MD and adjust the intensity and mode based on client comfort and treatment goals.
  3. Lift & Glide – Glide the probes slowly
    over targeted areas like the forehead, cheeks, jawline, and neck, following professional guidelines.
  4. Pinch & Hold – For deep lifting, hold probes on areas prone to sagging for longer activation.
  5. Finish – Remove any remaining gel
    and apply Anti-Aging Serum or Revital-C Serum for
    added hydration and long-lasting results.
  6. Recommended Use – Integrate into luxury spa facials as part of a customized treatment plan, tailored to
    client needs.

Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: What is the difference between the Myolift MD and the Myolift 600 plus?
settings.text1:
The Myolift MD comes with 8 difference waveform patterns as well as 8 preset
programs. It has an intensity level of 175-800 microamps and also has 9 customizable
options to create your own preset programs.
The Myolift 600 plus has 3 waveform patterns with intensities ranging from 175 - 650
microamps.
settings.title2: What are the waveforms that the Myolift MD comes with?
settings.text2:
The Myolift MD has:
Circulation: a waveform that works on the skin to get the blood to flow and helps to loosen
up toxins under the skin.
Lymphatic: has a specifically designed pumping waveform to stimulate the lymphatic
system and promote drainage.
Erase: Relaxes those muscles that become tight from overuse. Targets fine lines and
wrinkles to help smooth the skin.
Light Lift: one of the lifting waveforms that targets the finer muscles of the face
Educate: another of the lifting waveforms, Re-educates and strengthens facial muscles,
providing lift and improved tone
Deep Lift: targets the deeper facial muscles of the face to bring a longer hold to those areas
Firming: a waveform that helps to tighten the surface of the skin and helps to promote ATP
in the skin cells to bring a nice glow.
Iontophoresis: a waveform to help push serums in deeper, can also be used with sheet
masks and numbing creams to help lessen the time
settings.title3: Is training provided with the Myolift MD?
settings.text3: Yes, you will get a one on one training (via zoom) and you also will have access to the portal that will have video tutorials, consent forms as well as other materials to help you. We do also offer free webinars that you will be able to attend and we do have educators that are always available to answer any questions you may have. Our goal is to set you up for success!
settings.title4: Is the Myolift MD hard to learn?
settings.text4:
No, the Myolift MD is a touch screen device and is very user friendly. You have all
the options at your fingertips and can increase or decrease the intensity, can adjust the time
as well as choose your waveform. You have the 9 customizable treatments that you can
create to make it easier when doing a series or if you want to combine with other modalities
and have it preset into the device. There are also preset programs that are built into the
device if you want to just select one and go. Each preset has different timings and different
waveforms to target certain areas of the face. We have done all the work for you. The
Myolift MD is the ultimate professional device that delivers the results you're looking for.
